expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Reopening was well known and 春秋's frozen 2023E PE was about 35x. The sector basket underperformed the benchmark over both 20 and 60 days.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Summer domestic/international load factor and yield improvement can lift earnings further.
expectations.measurableGap: Company fundamentals are improving, but valuation and adverse sector timing leave limited asymmetry versus 吉祥.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Recovery-year forward PE plus load-factor/yield and cash-profit conversion versus profitable airline peers.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Summer demand, yield and utilization exceed the already-recovery-oriented 2023 baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Earnings must rise faster than current recovery expectations and compensate for a high 2023 multiple.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Traffic improves but fare/cost normalization leaves profit near consensus while the multiple compresses.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Summer traffic and H1 results lie within 20-60 trading days.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: Official holiday and May passenger data show continuing reopening demand recovery.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: 春秋 Q1 returned to profit and positive operating cash flow.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: 吉祥 also returned to profit while 国航 remained loss-making, so 春秋 is strong but not uniquely dominant.

baselineLag.rationale: May passenger recovery and summer demand could exceed the Apr28 forecast assumptions.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Use frozen adverse aviation basket and high recovery-year PE.

priceRegime.method: equal-weight frozen airline basket versus CSI300

fundamentalImpulse.rationale: Passenger traffic continued recovering into May/holiday periods.

earningsRevisionBreadth.rationale: Private airlines 春秋/吉祥 had turned profitable, while 国航 still had large losses.

eventHalfLife.rationale: Domestic/international reopening and utilization normalization extend across multiple quarters.

opportunityTimingTest.rationale: Fundamentals improve but the broad price regime remains adverse.

qualityFloor.rationale: Profit and operating cash flow have already turned positive.

revisionHeadroom.rationale: Summer utilization/yield can lift earnings above the April forecast.

catalystReachability.rationale: Summer operations/H1 results are inside the base horizon.

downsideContainment.rationale: Low-cost model helps, but high recovery-year valuation plus fuel/FX risk can compress returns.

pairwise.valuationAdvantage: No clear advantage; 春秋's 2023E PE is high.
pairwise.qualityTradeoff: Both pass; 春秋 has low-cost strength, 吉祥 broader full-service/international recovery torque.
pairwise.downsideTradeoff: 春秋 operating model is stronger, but valuation offsets some protection.
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch if 吉祥's unit economics/earnings revisions accelerate at a lower valuation.

pairwise.valuationAdvantage: Loss-making 国航 makes PE comparison unreliable.

pairwise.catalystAdvantage: 春秋 can compound existing profitability rather than first cross breakeven.
pairwise.downsideTradeoff: 国航 fixed-cost and international recovery risk is larger.
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch only after 国航 realizes a stronger profit inflection.
